fields.description: Assets whose Asset Category is listed here are treated as "drives on public roads" — they are the ones offered for selection on Vehicle Allocation, and the ones the Fleet Compliance Overview report enumerates.
fields.label: Public Road Asset Categories

fields.description: Restricts every Fleet dashboard, report, Excel export and email notification to only Company-owned Assets whose Company is listed here. Leave this, Included Suppliers AND Included Customers all empty to disable Reporting Scope entirely (include every Asset) — but once any one of the three tables has a row, an empty table for a given owner type means NO Asset of that type qualifies (e.g. an empty Included Companies then means no Company-owned Asset shows, not "every Company is fine"). To keep showing Supplier- or Customer-owned Assets once you've started using this, you must still list them explicitly in their own table.
fields.label: Included Companies

fields.description: Restricts every Fleet dashboard, report, Excel export and email notification to only Supplier-owned Assets whose Supplier is listed here. Same all-or-nothing-per-table rule as Included Companies: once any of the three Reporting Scope tables has a row, an empty Included Suppliers means NO Supplier-owned Asset qualifies — it is not treated as "every Supplier is fine".
fields.label: Included Suppliers

fields.description: Restricts every Fleet dashboard, report, Excel export and email notification to only Customer-owned Assets whose Customer is listed here. Same all-or-nothing-per-table rule as Included Companies/Suppliers: once any of the three Reporting Scope tables has a row, an empty Included Customers means NO Customer-owned Asset qualifies — it is not treated as "every Customer is fine".
fields.label: Included Customers

fields.description: A Licence (driver's licence or Vehicle Licence) is flagged "Expiring" once its expiry date falls within this many days.
fields.label: Expiring Threshold (Days)

fields.description: Sent once a week, Sundays at 00:00 server time — Frappe's native Weekly scheduled job, no custom timing.
fields.label: Send Weekly Digest

fields.description: Checks every Current, submitted Vehicle Allocation's Drivers for anyone whose Employee status is Left, or who has a Termination Form on file, and notifies the Terminated Driver Alert Recipients for that Location. Sent once a day at 00:00 server time — Frappe's native Daily scheduled job, no custom timing.
fields.label: Send Terminated Driver Alert

fields.description: Notifies the Temporary Loan Digest Recipients, per Location, of every active "Is Temporary Loan" Vehicle Allocation. Sent once a day at 00:00 server time — Frappe's native Daily scheduled job, no custom timing.
fields.label: Send Temporary Loan Digest

fields.description: Who receives the Weekly Compliance Digest (expiring/expired Driver and Vehicle Licences, Company Vehicle Undertakings, unregistered Assets). A separate list from the two daily alerts below — add the same person to more than one list if they need all three.
fields.label: Weekly Compliance Digest Recipients

fields.description: Who receives the daily Terminated Driver Alert (a Vehicle Allocation has a Driver who is Terminated or Pending Termination). A separate list from the other two.
fields.label: Terminated Driver Alert Recipients

fields.description: Who receives the daily Temporary Loan Digest (active "Is Temporary Loan" Vehicle Allocations). A separate list from the other two.
fields.label: Temporary Loan Digest Recipients
